lines.trans: Kostya, have you finished preparing the drinks?
Yes, all orders are already ready.
Why did Max run away from here so quickly?
He was simply in a big hurry to get to the kitchen.
It seems to me that he is behaving strangely.
Max is always a slightly strange guy.
Did he not say anything to you about me?
We spoke only about our work.
Are you definitely telling me the pure truth?
Of course, I never deceive you.
Fine, then I will ask him myself.
It is better not to disturb him right now, Vika.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

вести.gloss: to lead, to conduct (вести себя = to behave)

meanings.en: to lead, to guide, to drive
вести себя: to behave, to conduct oneself
meanings.note: Вы как маленькая себя ведёте = You're behaving like a little girl

examples.trans: You're behaving like a little girl.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: usually the short form: я готов (m), я готова (f)

meanings.en: to finish, to end, to complete

examples.trans: I want to finish what I started.

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I need to do a bit of work.

meanings.note: used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
+ prepositional; об before a vowel: об этом

meanings.en: other forms: его (gen/acc), ему (dat), им (instr), нём (prep)

examples.trans: I love our town very much.
Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: as a side word: Правда, всё нормально = Honestly, everything's fine

спешить.gloss: to hurry, be in a rush

meanings.en: to hurry, rush, be in a hurry
meanings.note: куда ты спешишь? = where are you rushing to?

examples.trans: What happened? Where are you rushing to?
We are in a big hurry for the train.

meanings.en: to ask (a question, or someone: спросить у кого-то)

examples.text: А спросите у него, куда он дел компьютерный класс.
examples.trans: Ask him where he put the computer lab.

meanings.note: at the start of a question

examples.trans: So I shouldn't wait for you?

examples.text: Я точно не помню его адрес.
examples.trans: I don't remember his exact address.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: irregular mixed conjugation: убегу, убежишь, ..., убегут

examples.trans: The dog ran away into the courtyard.

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.note: short form чисто: всё чисто = everything is clean

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
